verdicts.rationale: DEFECT CONFIRMED - Type1_IllegalSuccess: DELETE with filter 'age in [10, 5]' reports successful deletion (deleteCount=1) but does not actually delete any entities. Independent verification via subsequent queries confirms all original entities still exist. REST v2 handler correctly parses the expression and proxy layer correctly identifies 1 matching entity (id=1 with age=10), but the actual delete operation fails silently while reporting success. This is a data integrity violation - users believe data is deleted when it is not, leading to stale data exposure and potential data consistency issues. Matches 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' blindspot pattern where REST v2 layer reports success but underlying operation fails.

physical.objective_constraint: deleteCount must equal actual number of entities removed from storage
